wire.memory.title: Memory
wire.memory.command: Inspect, search, correct or forget scoped memory
wire.memory.description: Bounded local recall and best-effort compaction capture; retrieved facts are untrusted.
wire.memory.enabled.label: Scoped memory
wire.memory.enabled.help: Enable the bounded SQLite memory bank. Turning this off does not erase retained facts.
wire.memory.capture.label: Compaction capture
wire.memory.capture.help: Capture safe locators after committed compactions; context-full also reuses its existing summary. Explicit stores remain the guaranteed route for goals and decisions.
wire.memory.suggest.label: Recall suggestions
wire.memory.suggest.help: Suggest up to three untrusted titles from the current user message, within a separate 180-token cap. No network or embedding request.
wire.memory.sync.label: Trusted-peer memory sync
wire.memory.sync.help: Incrementally share selected scopes with existing paired receiver-admin peers supporting memory-sync-v1. This includes session memories without copying transcripts.
wire.memory.scopes.label: Memory scopes to sync
wire.memory.scopes.help: Only these namespaces are shared. Session, team and agent owners remain exact registry/session IDs; all four scopes are supported.
wire.memory.exclude.label: Excluded memory peers
wire.memory.exclude.help: Device IDs excluded from memory replication. This does not change pairing, trust or enrollment grants.
